items.summary: Recommendation: maintain containment-only execution. Fleet control-plane throughput is the dominant friction: 197 approved proposals lack execution requests, 46 failed-request repairs remain open, 27 deployed improvements await measurement, and only 1 outcome is proven. Retain the backlog themes of canonical lineage/deduplication, capability-aware routing, measurement-readiness gates, and unified repair-or-close workflows, but create no new proposals, work items, change requests, telemetry, requeues, or production work while capacity is occupied. Continue existing source-dated measurement, attribution reconciliation, failure repair-or-close review, and bounded legal/security evidence work. Keep the gated product private.
